page_title: MON 0-1 NAP | Monza v Napoli 19/04/2025, Stats - Flashscore.com | Match

commentary.text: 90+4' There will be no more action in this match as the referee signals full time.
90+4' Good work from Monza as they win a corner.
90+2' Monza force their opponents to concede a corner.
90' There will be a minimum of 3 min. of added time.
90' Cyril Ngonge (Napoli) is booked after bringing down an opponent. Federico La Penna had an easy-decision to make.
90' Flag goes up against Giovanni Simeone (Napoli) and the referee blows his whistle for offside.
88' Napoli are showcasing great team work and neat passing moves.
86' Luca Caldirola (Monza) commits a foul and is shown a yellow card without any hesitation from the referee.
85' The referee signals that it is time for a substitution and Cyril Ngonge (Napoli) will replace Matteo Politano.
84' Alessandro Nesta has decided to substitute Gaetano Castrovilli and he is replaced by Patrick Ciurria (Monza).
84' Alessandro Bianco will be replaced by Kacper Urbanski (Monza).
82' Federico La Penna couldn't ignore the rough tackle by Giacomo Raspadori (Napoli) and blew his whistle.
81' Giacomo Raspadori (Napoli) unleashes a powerful shot towards goal, but it is bravely blocked by a self-sacrificing defender.
79' Antonio Conte prepares a substitution. Romelu Lukaku is replaced by Giovanni Simeone (Napoli).
76' The referee signals that it is time for a substitution and Silvere Ganvoula (Monza) comes onto the pitch so that Samuele Birindelli can be given a rest.
75' 5:14 – the total goal attempt statistics.
72' 0 - 1 Goal! Scott McTominay (Napoli) ran onto a clever lofted pass from Giacomo Raspadori and easily beat the keeper with a header into the roof of the net from close range. 0:1.
70' Alessandro Bianco (Monza) receives a yellow card from the referee for a foul that he committed a little earlier.
69' Matteo Politano (Napoli) has a great chance inside the six-yard box, shoots low to the middle of the goal, but Stefano Turati pulls off an exquisite save to deny him.
67' Alessandro Nesta decides to make a substitution. Jean-Daniel Akpa Akpro will be replaced by Roberto Gagliardini (Monza).
67' Georgios Kyriakopoulos (Monza) sends in a poor cross from the corner and Alex Meret has no trouble gathering it.
66' 0:2 – this is the current number of shots on target.
64' Substitution. Mathias Olivera makes his way off the pitch and Giacomo Raspadori (Napoli) comes on as his replacement.
62' The ball is cleared after Matteo Politano (Napoli) attempted to dribble past an opposing player.
60' Pedro Pereira (Monza) makes a rough challenge and Federico La Penna blows his whistle for a foul.
59' Monza players are exchanging short passes with one another, waiting for the right moment to beat the opposition's defence.
57' Luca Caldirola (Monza) outjumps his marker on the edge of the 6-yard box and heads the resulting corner well wide of the right post.
56' Georgios Kyriakopoulos (Monza) goes over to take the corner kick and it looks like he will swing the ball into the penalty box.
54' Jean-Daniel Akpa Akpro (Monza) is cautioned by the referee for a foul that he committed a little earlier.
53' Matteo Politano (Napoli) will try to find the head of one of his teammates from a corner kick.
51' Matteo Politano (Napoli) manages to dispossess his opponent of the ball, but he commits a foul in the process and the referee blows his whistle.
49' Leonardo Spinazzola (Napoli) found some space to dink a cross from the side into the box, but it needed to be more precise to threaten the opposition.
48' Jean-Daniel Akpa Akpro (Monza) commits a rough foul. Federico La Penna stops the game and makes a call.
46' Gianluca Caprari (Monza) produces a quality cross into the box, but the opposition's defence intercepts the ball and spanks it away.
46' Antonio Conte makes a switch. Frank Anguissa (Napoli) is coming on in place of Billy Gilmour at the start of the second period.
46' Everything is set for the start of the second half.
45+1' Federico La Penna blows his whistle to signal the end of the first-half action.
45' The fourth official shows 1 min. of added time.
44' Matteo Politano (Napoli) finds himself free inside the box and pulls the trigger, but his effort is brilliantly stopped by one of the defending players.
42' The referee awards a corner and Georgios Kyriakopoulos (Monza) goes over to take it.
40' Stanislav Lobotka (Napoli) was too forceful with his tackle and Federico La Penna interrupted the game to signal a free kick.
36' Leonardo Spinazzola (Napoli) races towards goal but the defender gets back well to make a challenge.
36' The current number of shots on target for both teams is 2:8.
33' Dany Mota (Monza) has to be very careful for the rest of the match after receiving a yellow card from the referee for a bad tackle on an opponent.
32' Matteo Politano (Napoli) fails to beat the offside trap and the linesman puts his flag up.
30' Rafa Marin (Napoli) shouldn't be surprised it's a yellow from the ref, who cooled the situation down well.
29' Gaetano Castrovilli (Monza) makes a good run with the ball into the box, but mishits his shot as it goes way wide of the left post.
27' Rafa Marin (Napoli) shoots from the edge of the penalty area. The ball travels towards the bottom left corner, but Stefano Turati easily deals with the threat.
25' The foul by Rafa Marin (Napoli) was seen by Federico La Penna who didn't hesitate to blow the whistle.
25' There's an opportunity for Billy Gilmour (Napoli) to deliver the ball into the box from a corner.
22' Billy Gilmour (Napoli) looks like he will be the one to take the corner kick.
22' Romelu Lukaku (Napoli) latches onto a cross into the box from the wing and gets in a header. It went well towards the goal, but it was blocked by one of the defenders.
20' Federico La Penna blows for a foul after Alessandro Bianco (Monza) was too aggressive in the battle for the ball.
19' A dangerous towering header by Amir Rrahmani (Napoli) from around the penalty spot goes just wide of the right post. This corner kick didn't change the score.
18' Billy Gilmour (Napoli) takes the ball to the corner flag and sends it into the box.
18' Scott McTominay (Napoli) fires the ball at goal from inside the area, but it's well blocked.
17' Scott McTominay (Napoli) stands over the free kick and opts to take it himself, but his low effort is straight at Stefano Turati.
16' Gianluca Caprari (Monza) makes an overly-aggressive challenge and Federico La Penna blows his whistle for a foul. Napoli win a free kick. It's a promising situation for a direct shot.
16' Billy Gilmour (Napoli) puts a cross into the box from the corner but there is no panic from the opposition and they easily clear.
15' Monza take a short corner instead of sending the ball into the penalty area.
14' Federico La Penna blows the whistle, Stanislav Lobotka (Napoli) is penalised for a foul.
14' Matteo Politano (Napoli) takes the corner kick, but Stefano Turati reads it well and stops the effort.
11' Samuele Birindelli (Monza) takes a shot from the edge of the area, but it goes harmlessly wide of the right post.
10' Napoli keep the ball and are displaying some tiki-taka style passing at the moment.
7' Matteo Politano (Napoli) swings in the corner, but fails to find any of his teammates. One of the defenders reacts superbly to get it clear.

5' Dany Mota (Monza) is obviously not following the Golden Rule: "Treat others as you want to be treated.“ He makes a bad challenge and leaves Federico La Penna with no other option than to blow for a foul.
2' Mathias Olivera (Napoli) decides to strike the ball towards goal, but his effort fails to threaten the goalkeeper after being well blocked by one of the defenders.
1' The first half has started.
Napoli will kick the game off.
Federico La Penna will officiate today.
